subject: Money
title: Central Bank Digital Currencies
description: A short lesson to help you apply Central Bank Digital Currencies.

hook.text: China's digital yuan has 260 million wallets. The government can see every transaction in real time.

buildup.text: CBDCs are government-issued digital money. Unlike crypto, they're centralized and fully controlled.

discovery.text: CBDCs could eliminate bank runs. If you hold money directly at the central bank, no intermediary can fail.

twist.text: But CBDCs give governments total surveillance of spending. Every purchase, every transfer, every dollar tracked.

climax.text: CBDCs offer efficiency and control. The question is: who benefits more—citizens or the state?

punchline.text: Digital money. Total visibility. Choose wisely.

quiz.question: What is a key concern about CBDCs?
